messages.shop.guide.chassis: Includes the chassis, fans and two 600 W redundant PSUs. Install a compatible CPU and RAM before requesting power; NICs and drives are purchased separately.
messages.shop.guide.full-pack: Includes an Intel Xeon E-2434, 16 GB DDR5 ECC RAM, an Intel I350-T4 four-port NIC, a 960 GB SATA SSD, fans and redundant PSUs.
messages.shop.guide.copper: Bulk stock is cut into Ethernet leads. Each new lead consumes its selected length and two RJ45 plugs. Finished optical assemblies use separate inventory.
messages.shop.guide.modules: Pluggable transceivers are sold separately. Match cage type, supported speed and power budget; DAC/AOC assemblies have integrated ends.
messages.shop.guide.fiber: LC fiber patches need suitable optical modules at active endpoints. Match fiber grade, strand arrangement and supported reach.
messages.shop.guide.bidi: BiDi needs a complementary U/D module at the other end and simplex OS2 fiber. Transmit and receive wavelengths must be paired.
messages.shop.guide.assembly: A complete assembly includes both transceiver ends. It is purchased and reused as one item and consumes no bulk copper cable or RJ45 plugs.
messages.shop.guide.ipv4: Purchases a simulated /29 address range. Open IP Ranges to select its delivery uplink and configure routing. Ownership alone does not connect it.
